candidates.reason: Best rearrangement: logo, bottle and card read left to right with a clear headline, then CTA. Flaws: the logo badge is crowded against the bottle, and the bottle sits awkwardly over the card's left edge. The legal text is tiny and illegible at banner size. The body copy wraps raggedly into two lines that sit too close to the CTA.

The Order a Case button runs off the right canvas edge and over the card's border, and the card itself bleeds off the right side. The headline is barely larger than the body copy. The legal line is as big as the body, which flattens the hierarchy. The logo is shrunk to a tiny, nearly invisible dot at the bottom, so the brand is lost. The bottle sits on busy confetti.

This is just the original portrait layout shrunk into the centre of the banner. The headline, body, CTA and legal text are microscopic and unreadable. About 80% of the canvas is confetti, so it fails to fit the format at all.

Same structure as candidate 2, with slightly better centred text alignment. Still, the CTA is jammed against the right canvas edge, and the card is cut off at the right. The legal text is as large as the body copy. The logo is reduced to a tiny dot, so the brand mark is effectively lost. The headline only weakly dominates.
